plan.notes: Official ASU major map (Sustainability, BA, plan SUSUSTBA, campus ASU00); term-by-term sequence as published; retrieved 2026-10-06. One map row = one seed slot. 'X or Y' alternatives transcribed as one choice slot (choice=true). Rows with large option pools transcribed as one choice slot naming the requirement. Gen-ed placeholders (no course link on the map) transcribed verbatim as choice slots. Map 'Term hours subtotal' rows are metadata, not courses (wave-33 convention). The official map lists the following slot(s) in more than one term; transcribed as shown with allow_repeated_courses per the genuine-repeat rule: ENG 101 OR ENG 102: First-Year Composition OR ENG 105: Advanced First-Year Composition OR ENG 107 OR ENG 108: First-Year Composition; Humanities, Arts and Design (HUAD); SOS 320: Society and Sustainability (SOBE OR L or SB) OR SOS 321: Policy and Governance in Sustainable Systems OR SOS 322: International Development and Sustainability OR SOS 323: Sustainable Urban Dynamics OR SOS 324: Sustainable Energy Technology and Systems OR SOS 325: The Economics of Sustainability OR SOS 326: Sustainable Ecosystems OR SOS 327: Sustainable Food and Farms OR SOS 328: Sustainability and Enterprise OR SOS 465: Sustainable Urbanism; Scientific Thinking in Natural Sciences (SCIT); Second Language: Requirement satisfied through the following: * Completion of a language course at the intermediate level (202 or equivalent), including American Sign Language IV.; Upper Division Elective; Upper Division Related Discipline Elective.
